name: Funding-fear confluence with momentum-recovery confirm (no falling-knife)
rationale: Pure capitulation entries can keep falling (the falling-knife problem). This spec arms the funding+fear composite but adds a SHORT-lookback recovery confirm: enter long only when funding is soft (below ceiling) AND Fear&Greed is fearful AND the most-recent short-window return has already turned UP (ret over a short lookback above a small floor) — i.e. wait for the first bounce after the flush rather than catching the knife. Funding+fear establish the contrarian context; the tiny positive momentum confirms the market has stopped falling. Funding is a crowding filter (null carry); its ceiling straddles realized levels so it bites. The short-lookback ret floor is small and positive so it filters timing, not regime. DISCONFIRMER: the recovery-confirm leg IS the test — a sibling WITHOUT the ret confirm is in this cohort. If the unconfirmed composite already matches the deflated Sharpe, the confirm is decorative; if the strategy only works WITH a meaningful positive momentum floor, then the edge is largely momentum-in-disguise and the fear/funding contrarian thesis is weak. Holdout must hold. Gate disposes.
catalyst: fear + soft funding followed by first short-window upturn
